Indikator 15 evaluates the quality of care and subsequent outcomes for patients newly diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] in [[danmark|Danmark]]. The indicator tracks severe complications occurring within one year of diagnosis. Based on the available reports, the specific complication measured shifted between reporting periods: the 2023 report tracks the incidence of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke), while the 2024 report tracks the development of heart failure (hjertesvigt).

**Targets Met and Missed**
Across both reporting periods and all geographical levels, no region or health cluster successfully met the established clinical standard. The "Standard opfyldt" (standard met) metric remained at 0 (0) for every single entity evaluated in both the 2021/22 stroke data and the 2022/23 heart failure data [^src1] [^src2].

**Ischemic Stroke (2019/20 – 2021/22)**
For the development of ischemic stroke within one year, the national average in 2021/22 was 1.1% [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] recorded the highest rate among the five regions at 1.4%, while [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] recorded the lowest at 0.8% [^src1]. The data reveals a general downward trend from 2019/20 to 2021/22 for most regions; for example, the national rate dropped from 1.2% to 1.1% [^src1]. An outlier to this steady decline was [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], which saw its rate fluctuate from 0.9% in 2019/20 to 1.1% in 2020/21, before dropping to 0.8% in 2021/22 [^src1].

**Heart Failure (2020/21 – 2022/23)**
The 2024 data expands the granularity to include local health clusters (sundhedsklynger) and measures the onset of heart failure. Nationally, the rate of heart failure within one year dropped significantly from 9.0% in 2020/21 to 6.1% in 2022/23 [^src2]. In the most recent period (2022/23), [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] was the leader with the highest complication rate at 8.5%, followed closely by [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]] (8.0%) and [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] (7.5%) [^src2]. Conversely, the trailers with the lowest rates were [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]] and [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]], both achieving a rate of 4.5% [^src2]. Despite the universal downward trend across all clusters, [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] remains an outlier of concern; although it improved drastically from 10.5% in 2020/21, it still ranked among the worst-performing clusters in 2022/23 [^src2].

- "På regionsniveau varierede andelen som blev indlagt med alvorlig blødning mellem 1,9-2,2%" — see [[epidemiological|Epidemiological]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src23]

- "Indikator 8 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren som får et struktureret undervisningsprogram indenfor 1 år efter diagnosen er stillet" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src33]
- "Såfremt de anførte 95% CI for indikatorværdien ikke omfatter standardværdien, kan det konkluderes, at afdelingen ligger enten over eller under den opstillede standard, og at forskellen i forhold til standarden ikke kan forklares ved tilfældig variation. Der foreligger med andre ord en statistisk signifikant forskel" — see [[statistical-interpretation|Statistical Interpretation]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src32]
- "Omfaatter 95% CI derimod standardværdien, er det ikke muligt at afgøre om indikatorværdien med sikkerhed adskiller sig fra den opstillede standard" — see [[statistical-interpretation|Statistical Interpretation]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src32]
